interface.title: gitma_CANSpiN (Streamlit GUI, version 1.7.0)
interface.field: Digital humanities / computational literary studies (annotating texts in CATMA)
interface.stage_of_work: Managing and post-processing manual annotations: registering a project, then exporting, analysing and merging annotations
interface.what_it_is_for: A local GUI where a researcher links a CATMA annotation project with an access token, then exports annotation collections to TSV/TEI, computes statistics and agreement between annotators, and builds gold-standard collections.

data.note: The app has no built-in or example data. Everything it works on comes from the CATMA GitLab backend (git.catma.de), which this sandbox cannot reach. Any token request fails with requests.exceptions.ProxyError ('Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden'). No upload path or test files exist. The first page load took about two minutes to leave the 'Running…' skeleton screen (screens/002.webp–screens/008.webp).

tree.general: Turn the manual annotation sets of a remote annotation project into exported tables, descriptive statistics, agreement measures and a merged reference set
tree.specific: Use gitma_CANSpiN to export CATMA annotation collections to token TSV and TEI XML, compute class statistics and gamma agreement, and build strict-mode gold-standard collections. This run reached only the first phase, project registration, and that phase failed at the token check.

features.name: Credential-checked 'create connection' dialog with remote folder picker
features.general: A modal form where the user gives a free label and an access token. The tool checks the token live against the remote service and lists the remote projects that token can reach. The user picks one as the working project, and Save is enabled only after that. Each field has a help tooltip explaining where to get the value.
features.specific: The Create project dialog has 'Enter a project name' (any label) and 'Enter a valid CATMA access token'. On Enter it calls get_folder_names_from_gitlab against git.catma.de. On success, a 'Select the folder name of your project' radio lists the folders (projects.py:46, not reached in this run), and Save project becomes enabled. Clearing the token restores the empty form.
features.note: In this sandbox the token check always failed. The dialog showed a raw requests.exceptions.ProxyError traceback, including server file paths, and hid Save project. The handler in projects.py:231-234 catches only Gitlab exceptions, so the '404: Connection failed' message never appears.
steps: press Create to open the modal
hover the ? icons to read what the name and token mean
type a label and an access token, pressing Enter to submit each
pick the remote project folder from the list the token returns (radio in projects.py:46; not reached)
press Save project once it is enabled
on a failed check, clear or correct the token to retry, or close the dialog

features.name: Project selector with gated navigation
features.general: A picker for saved items with Create, Edit and Delete actions and a status banner. The sidebar menu enables the downstream work views only once an item is selected.
features.specific: The Projects card has Create, Edit and Delete buttons, a 'Select a CATMA project' dropdown and a 'Currently no project is selected.' banner. Saved projects persist in gui_configs/projects.json. The sidebar Main Menu greys out AnnotationExporter, AnnotationAnalyzer and AnnotationManipulator until currently_loaded_project is set. This run saw only the locked state.

use Edit or Delete on the chosen project
go to an unlocked analysis page in the sidebar
